categories.name: Total Power Outage
categories.description: Complete absence of electricity at consumer premises or across neighborhood.

categories.name: Fallen Power Line
categories.residentLabel: Fallen live wire / cable on ground
categories.description: High or medium voltage overhead cable dropped to ground, road, or structure.
categories.safetyWarning: EXTREME DANGER: Stay at least 15 meters (50 feet) away! Do NOT touch vehicles or puddles near the line.

categories.name: Broken or Exposed Wire
categories.description: Exposed insulation, severed conductor, or sparking drop line near residential roof/verandah.
categories.safetyWarning: SAFETY WARNING: Keep all children and bystanders clear of the structure. Do not use metal sticks or water.

categories.name: Damaged Transformer
categories.residentLabel: Transformer smoking, leaking, or making loud hums
categories.description: Pole-mounted or ground distribution transformer experiencing dielectric failure, humming loudly, or smoking.
categories.safetyWarning: Do not approach the transformer perimeter fence. Avoid inhaling fumes if burning oil is present.

categories.name: Sparks / Electrical Fire
categories.residentLabel: Sparks or active fire at pole / meter box
categories.description: Active electrical arcing, glowing junctions, or flame on electrical hardware.
categories.safetyWarning: DANGER: Never use water on an energized electrical fire. Alert occupants and keep distance.

categories.name: Damaged or Leaning Pole
categories.residentLabel: Electric pole broken, cracked, or leaning over
categories.description: Wooden or concrete utility pole fractured by storm, vehicle impact, or soil erosion.
categories.safetyWarning: Avoid standing or driving beneath a leaning pole with heavy conductor tension.

categories.name: Low Voltage / Unstable Supply
categories.residentLabel: Low voltage / Dim bulbs / Fluctuating power
categories.description: Supply voltage dipping below 190V, causing electronic damage, humming refrigerators, or brownouts.

categories.name: Partial / Single-Phase Outage
categories.residentLabel: Some rooms have power, others do not (Single phase lost)
categories.description: Loss of one phase on 3-phase domestic feed or localized service drop clamp detachment.

categories.name: Street / Public Lighting Defect
categories.residentLabel: Public streetlight not working or broken fixture
categories.description: Public municipal lighting failure or day-burning fixtures along thoroughfares.

categories.name: Other Electricity Problem
categories.residentLabel: Other electrical issue not listed above
categories.description: Other electricity problem requiring utility dispatch attention.

reports.description: The whole street lost power suddenly around 4:00 PM during the light drizzle. Refrigerator and lights all died together.
Neighboring shop also has zero power here near Kigongi clinic. Please restore supply before nightfall.
High wind knocked a tree branch onto the 11kV conductor along Rushoroza Hill. Live cable is hanging 1 meter over the pedestrian pathway!
The pole-mounted distribution transformer near Katuna Road junction made a loud explosion sound and oil is dripping down the wooden cross-arm.
Voltage dropped so low that energy bulbs only glow orange. Voltage measured at 165V with multimeter.

incidents.title: Kigongi Feeder Phase Trip & Blackout
incidents.description: Widespread low-voltage grid outage across Kigongi Ward following primary feeder circuit-breaker trip.

incidents.title: Downed 11kV Overhead Cable across Rushoroza Pathway
incidents.description: High-voltage conductor severed by eucalyptus limb. Public safety risk on access road to cathedral & hospital.

incidents.title: Kabale Central Market Transformer Neutral Fault
incidents.description: Floating neutral fault burned out service fuses for market stalls.
incidents.resolutionNote: Replaced neutral bonding clamp and renewed HT drop-out fuses. Load test verified 238V balance.
incidents.residentFeedbackComment: Power returned cleanly. Good communication from dispatch.

incidents.title: Kikungiri Campus Spur Line Sparking Defect
incidents.description: Arcing connector on terminal pole supplying academic buildings.
incidents.resolutionNote: Insulated bypass jumper installed on phase B.
incidents.residentDisputeReason: Sparks returned immediately when night campus floodlights switched on. Transformer still humming loudly.

assignments.notes: Urgent municipal feeder fault. Dispatched with boom truck and fuse kit.
EMERGENCY: Fallen line on pedestrian route near Rushoroza Cathedral. Ensure isolation first.

workUpdates.note: Team Alpha mobilised with service vehicle UBG 412K. En route to Kigongi Ward substation.
Arrived at site. Isolated the 11kV section. Located cracked insulator pin on Pole #KBL-24. Preparing replacement assembly.
